subject: Interim attestation & coverage memo for expansion PO - audit window alignment
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@atlashealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Sweeney <matt.sweeney@atlashealth.com>, Atlas Health Procurement <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit window alignment needed for upcoming PO and renewal

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is pushing to get the expansion PO for Atlas Health finalized by the end of June. Before we can issue the PO and route to finance, we need confirmation of two things: the latest SOC 2 Type II report (covering the services we use) and a statement on whether there will be any audit-period coverage gap between your Type II report and our contract start date.

Specifically:
- Can you provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and the audit period dates?
- If there is an overlap/coverage gap, will Redwood provide an interim attestation or bridge letter that covers our contract start date through the next audit?
- We also requested answers to a short SIG subset earlier — is there an updated spreadsheet we can include with the PO package?

If possible, attach the documents or point me to a secure link. Our procurement deadline for the expansion PO is 2028-06-30.

Appreciate your help — this will speed things along on our side.

Best,
Julia
Julia Park
Sr. Procurement Manager, Atlas Health
Julia.Park@atlashealth.com

Attachments: None

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit window alignment needed for upcoming PO and renewal

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Priyom (compliance lead), Laura (legal/contracts), and Vanessa (customer success) so we can assemble the artifacts and a short memo for procurement.

Quick answers:
- Latest SOC 2 Type II: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (audit period: 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30). I will upload to a secure Drive link and share.
- Coverage gap: there is a period between 2027-07-01 and your requested contract effective date of 2028-07-01 that is not covered by the 2027 report. We typically offer an interim attestation/bridge letter for renewals/expansions that fall into such gaps.
- SIG/CAIQ: we have an updated SIG subset and a completed CAIQ export; I will attach a SIG spreadsheet with the most recent responses.

Action plan (internal):
- Priyom: prepare interim attestation memo that explicitly lists controls covered and any exceptions (target delivery 2028-06-07).
- Laura: review proposed language for procurement and confirm acceptance for DocuSign/PO gating (target review 2028-06-05).
- Vanessa: confirm whether CS will supply a short support note for internal Atlas reviewers describing how we handle fallback routing and data isolation for Dedicated deployments.

Julia, I will drop the SOC2 PDF and a preliminary SIG file into the Drive link and send the interim memo when it is signed. If procurement needs a notarized bridge letter we can escalate.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (attached to Drive link)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: michael.grant@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim attestation & coverage memo for expansion PO - audit window alignment

Team — draft interim attestation and SIG export attached for review. Key points in the memo:

- Attestation scope: production inference runtime and control domains A.1 (change mgmt), A.2 (access controls), A.4 (availability).
- Covered period: provisional coverage from 2027-07-01 through 2028-07-01 for the purposes of procurement acceptance only. This is not a full SOC re-audit; language clarifies it is an interim attestation based on maintained controls and quarterly monitoring since the last Type II date.
- Exceptions: none material; we call out a minor vendor onboarding control change that was remediated in Q4 2027 (details in appendix).
- Evidence bundle: controls mapping spreadsheet, sample logs (redacted), privileged access listing snapshot, and SIG subset (sheet: Atlas_SIG_subset).

Attachments: Interm_Attestation_DRAFT_2028-06-04.docx, SIG-full-responses-2028-06.xlsx, evidence-mapping.csv

Ask: Laura — please review the proposed legal language for acceptance by procurement. Vanessa — can you draft a 2-line customer-facing blurb summarizing how the interim attestation protects Atlas during the contract start window? Once legal signs off, I will convert the draft to PDF and prepare the DocuSign-ready bridge letter.

Thanks,
Priyom
Principal, Compliance & Trust
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com

From: Julia Park <julia.park@atlashealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Sweeney <matt.sweeney@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim attestation & coverage memo for expansion PO - audit window alignment

Michael/Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the draft interim attestation and the SIG subset. A couple of clarifying asks before we can accept:

1) We need the attestation letter to explicitly state that it will be appended to the PO as an exhibit and that Redwood agrees to supply us the full Type II report once published.
2) Can you confirm whether the provisional coverage end date can be set to 2028-08-01 instead of 2028-07-01 to give Atlas a 30-day ramp margin after the contract start?

If you can return an updated PDF with those two points and a DocuSign-ready signature block for Redwood legal, procurement can proceed to generate the PO and route for finance.

Best regards,
Julia

Attachments: Procurement_Checklist_Atlas_2028.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@atlashealth.com>, michael.grant@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interim attestation & coverage memo for expansion PO - audit window alignment

Hi Julia — Laura from Legal here. We updated the interim attestation PDF and added the requested exhibit language and an adjustable provisional end date. Changes made:

- Exhibit language: "This Interim Attestation shall be appended to the purchase order as Exhibit A and is intended to provide provisional coverage pending Redwood Inference's next SOC 2 Type II report. Redwood agrees to deliver the next full SOC 2 Type II report to Atlas Health upon issuance."
- Provisional coverage end date: set to 2028-08-01 per your request. We included a 30-day ramp margin clause and a DocuSign-ready signature block for Redwood's authorized signatory.

Attached: Interm_Attestation_FINAL_2028-06-07.pdf (signed by Legal counterparty placeholder); SIG-full-responses-2028-06.xlsx

Michael — Vanessa & Priyom and I are aligned to publish the final PDF to the Drive link and trigger DocuSign. Vanessa, can you confirm the short CS blurb so Julia can attach it to the PO package?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Interm_Attestation_FINAL_2028-06-07.pdf, SIG-full-responses-2028-06.xlsx
